verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 8.64
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 8.64

verses.pali: 7. Bhūmicālavagga
verses.english: 7. Earthquakes

verses.pali: Gayāsīsasutta
verses.english: At Gayā Head

verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā gayāyaṁ viharati gayāsīse.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying near Gayā on Gayā Head.

verses.pali: Tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi …pe…
verses.english: There the Buddha addressed the mendicants:

verses.pali: “pubbāhaṁ, bhikkhave, sambodhā anabhisambuddho bodhisattova samāno obhāsaññeva kho sañjānāmi, no ca rūpāni passāmi.
verses.english: “Mendicants, before my awakening—when I was still not awake but intent on awakening—I perceived light but did not see forms.

verses.pali: Tassa mayhaṁ, bhikkhave, etadahosi:
verses.english: Then it occurred to me,

verses.pali: ‘sace kho ahaṁ obhāsañceva sañjāneyyaṁ rūpāni ca passeyyaṁ;
verses.english: ‘What if I were to both perceive light and see forms?

verses.pali: evaṁ me idaṁ ñāṇadassanaṁ parisuddhataraṁ assā’ti.
verses.english: Then my knowledge and vision would become even more purified.’

verses.pali: So kho ahaṁ, bhikkhave, aparena samayena appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto obhāsañceva sañjānāmi, rūpāni ca passāmi;
verses.english: So after some time, living diligent, keen, and resolute, I perceived light and saw forms.

verses.pali: no ca kho tāhi devatāhi saddhiṁ santiṭṭhāmi sallapāmi sākacchaṁ samāpajjāmi.
verses.english: But I didn’t associate with those deities, converse, or engage in discussion.

verses.pali: Tassa mayhaṁ, bhikkhave, etadahosi:
verses.english: Then it occurred to me,

verses.pali: ‘sace kho ahaṁ obhāsañceva sañjāneyyaṁ, rūpāni ca passeyyaṁ, tāhi ca devatāhi saddhiṁ santiṭṭheyyaṁ sallapeyyaṁ sākacchaṁ samāpajjeyyaṁ;
verses.english: ‘What if I were to perceive light and see forms; and associate with those deities, converse, and engage in discussion?

verses.pali: evaṁ me idaṁ ñāṇadassanaṁ parisuddhataraṁ assā’ti.
verses.english: Then my knowledge and vision would become even more purified.’

verses.pali: So kho ahaṁ, bhikkhave, aparena samayena appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto obhāsañceva sañjānāmi, rūpāni ca passāmi, tāhi ca devatāhi saddhiṁ santiṭṭhāmi sallapāmi sākacchaṁ samāpajjāmi;
verses.english: So after some time … I perceived light and saw forms. And I associated with those deities, conversed, and engaged in discussion.

verses.pali: no ca kho tā devatā jānāmi—
verses.english: But I didn’t know which

verses.pali: imā devatā amukamhā vā amukamhā vā devanikāyāti.
verses.english: orders of gods those deities came from.

verses.pali: Tassa mayhaṁ, bhikkhave, etadahosi:
verses.english: Then it occurred to me,

verses.pali: ‘sace kho ahaṁ obhāsañceva sañjāneyyaṁ, rūpāni ca passeyyaṁ, tāhi ca devatāhi saddhiṁ santiṭṭheyyaṁ sallapeyyaṁ sākacchaṁ samāpajjeyyaṁ, tā ca devatā jāneyyaṁ:
verses.english: ‘What if I were to perceive light and see forms; and associate with those deities, converse, and engage in discussion;

verses.pali: “imā devatā amukamhā vā amukamhā vā devanikāyā”ti;
verses.english: and find out which orders of gods those deities come from?

verses.pali: evaṁ me idaṁ ñāṇadassanaṁ parisuddhataraṁ assā’ti.
verses.english: Then my knowledge and vision would become even more purified.’

verses.pali: So kho ahaṁ, bhikkhave, aparena samayena appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto obhāsañceva sañjānāmi, rūpāni ca passāmi, tāhi ca devatāhi saddhiṁ santiṭṭhāmi sallapāmi sākacchaṁ samāpajjāmi, tā ca devatā jānāmi:
verses.english: So after some time … I perceived light and saw forms. And I associated with those deities … And I found out which orders of gods those deities came from.

verses.pali: ‘imā devatā amukamhā vā amukamhā vā devanikāyā’ti;
no ca kho tā devatā jānāmi:
verses.english: But I didn’t know what

verses.pali: ‘imā devatā imassa kammassa vipākena ito cutā tattha upapannā’ti …pe…
verses.english: deeds caused those deities to be reborn there after passing away from here.

verses.pali: tā ca devatā jānāmi:
verses.english: So after some time … I found out what

verses.pali: ‘imā devatā imassa kammassa vipākena ito cutā tattha upapannā’ti;
verses.english: deeds caused those deities to be reborn there after passing away from here.

verses.pali: no ca kho tā devatā jānāmi:
verses.english: But I didn’t know what

verses.pali: ‘imā devatā imassa kammassa vipākena evamāhārā evaṁsukhadukkhappaṭisaṁvediniyo’ti …pe…
verses.english: deeds caused those deities to have such food and such an experience of pleasure and pain.

verses.pali: tā ca devatā jānāmi:
verses.english: So after some time … I found out what

verses.pali: ‘imā devatā imassa kammassa vipākena evamāhārā evaṁsukhadukkhappaṭisaṁvediniyo’ti;
verses.english: deeds caused those deities to have such food and such an experience of pleasure and pain.

verses.pali: no ca kho tā devatā jānāmi:
verses.english: But I didn’t know that

verses.pali: ‘imā devatā evaṁdīghāyukā evaṁciraṭṭhitikā’ti …pe…
verses.english: these deities have a lifespan of such a length.

verses.pali: tā ca devatā jānāmi:
verses.english: So after some time … I found out that

verses.pali: ‘imā devatā evaṁdīghāyukā evaṁciraṭṭhitikā’ti;
verses.english: these deities have a lifespan of such a length.

verses.pali: no ca kho tā devatā jānāmi yadi vā me imāhi devatāhi saddhiṁ sannivutthapubbaṁ yadi vā na sannivutthapubbanti.
verses.english: But I didn’t know whether or not I had previously lived together with those deities.

verses.pali: Tassa mayhaṁ, bhikkhave, etadahosi:
verses.english: Then it occurred to me,

verses.pali: ‘sace kho ahaṁ obhāsañceva sañjāneyyaṁ, rūpāni ca passeyyaṁ, tāhi ca devatāhi saddhiṁ santiṭṭheyyaṁ sallapeyyaṁ sākacchaṁ samāpajjeyyaṁ, tā ca devatā jāneyyaṁ:
verses.english: ‘What if I were to perceive light and see forms; and associate with those deities, converse, and engage in discussion;

verses.pali: “imā devatā amukamhā vā amukamhā vā devanikāyā”ti, tā ca devatā jāneyyaṁ:
verses.english: and find out which orders of gods those deities come from;

verses.pali: “imā devatā imassa kammassa vipākena ito cutā tattha upapannā”ti, tā ca devatā jāneyyaṁ:
verses.english: and what deeds caused those deities to be reborn there after passing away from here;

verses.pali: “imā devatā evamāhārā evaṁsukhadukkhappaṭisaṁvediniyo”ti, tā ca devatā jāneyyaṁ:
verses.english: and what deeds caused those deities to have such food and such an experience of pleasure and pain;

verses.pali: “imā devatā evaṁdīghāyukā evaṁciraṭṭhitikā”ti, tā ca devatā jāneyyaṁ yadi vā me imāhi devatāhi saddhiṁ sannivutthapubbaṁ yadi vā na sannivutthapubbanti;
verses.english: and that these deities have a lifespan of such a length; and whether or not I have previously lived together with those deities?

verses.pali: evaṁ me idaṁ ñāṇadassanaṁ parisuddhataraṁ assā’ti.
verses.english: Then my knowledge and vision would become even more purified.’

verses.pali: So kho ahaṁ, bhikkhave, aparena samayena appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto obhāsañceva sañjānāmi, rūpāni ca passāmi, tāhi ca devatāhi saddhiṁ santiṭṭhāmi sallapāmi sākacchaṁ samāpajjāmi, tā ca devatā jānāmi:
verses.english: So after some time …

verses.pali: ‘imā devatā amukamhā vā amukamhā vā devanikāyā’ti, tā ca devatā jānāmi:
‘imā devatā imassa kammassa vipākena ito cutā tattha upapannā’ti, tā ca devatā jānāmi:
‘imā devatā evamāhārā evaṁsukhadukkhappaṭisaṁvediniyo’ti, tā ca devatā jānāmi:
‘imā devatā evaṁdīghāyukā evaṁciraṭṭhitikā’ti, tā ca devatā jānāmi yadi vā me devatāhi saddhiṁ sannivutthapubbaṁ yadi vā na sannivutthapubbanti.
verses.english: I found out whether or not I have previously lived together with those deities.

verses.pali: Yāvakīvañca me, bhikkhave, evaṁ aṭṭhaparivaṭṭaṁ adhidevañāṇadassanaṁ na suvisuddhaṁ ahosi, neva tāvāhaṁ, bhikkhave, ‘sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṁ sammāsambodhiṁ abhisambuddho’ti paccaññāsiṁ.
verses.english: As long as my knowledge and vision about the deities was not fully purified in these eight rounds, I didn’t announce my supreme perfect awakening in this world with its gods, Māras, and Divinities, this population with its ascetics and brahmins, its gods and humans.

verses.pali: Yato ca kho me, bhikkhave, evaṁ aṭṭhaparivaṭṭaṁ adhidevañāṇadassanaṁ suvisuddhaṁ ahosi, athāhaṁ, bhikkhave, ‘sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṁ sammāsambodhiṁ abhisambuddho’ti paccaññāsiṁ;
verses.english: But when my knowledge and vision about the deities was fully purified in these eight rounds, I announced my supreme perfect awakening in this world with its gods, Māras, and Divinities, this population with its ascetics and brahmins, its gods and humans.

verses.pali: ñāṇañca pana me dassanaṁ udapādi;
verses.english: Knowledge and vision arose in me:

verses.pali: akuppā me cetovimutti; ayamantimā jāti natthi dāni punabbhavo”ti.
verses.english: ‘My freedom is unshakable; this is my last rebirth; now there’ll be no more future lives.’”

verses.pali: Catutthaṁ.
